description: This file defines the LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor class responsible for processing email notifications related to leave status changes within the OrangeHRM system. It handles constructing email content with dynamic replacements and determining recipients based on roles and leave events.

classes.name: LeaveStatusChangeEmailProcessor
classes.description: A PHP class that processes email notifications triggered by changes in leave status, extending functionality from AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor and implementing MailProcessor interface.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Generates an array of placeholder replacements for email templates based on leave status change event data.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Determines and returns the list of recipients for the leave status change notification email based on specified roles.

methods.name: verifyLeavesFromOneLeaveRequest
methods.description: Validates that all leave entries in the array belong to the same leave request, throwing an exception if not.
